name: function-hooks-core-reference
description: Pre-1.0 Function Hooks distribution with frozen 1.0-rc.1 kernel semantics, a fail-closed agent gateway, reusable routing, and admitted capability registries.

scripts.build: npm run link:workspaces && npm run build:packages && npm run build:compat
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:package-boundaries && npm run check:core-boundary && npm run check:portable-independence && npm run check:portable-platform && npm run check:umbrella-surface && npm run semantics:check && npm run api:check && npm run test:core && npm run test:portable && node tools/run-top-level-tests.mjs
scripts.qualify: npm run clean && npm run test && node dist/examples/demo.js && node dist/examples/isolated-demo.js && node dist/examples/split-kernel-demo.js && node dist/examples/conformance-demo.js && node dist/examples/portable-conformance-demo.js && node dist/examples/dual-runtime-demo.js && node dist/examples/compat-package-demo.js && node dist/examples/differential-qualification-demo.js && node dist/examples/agent-gateway-demo.js && node dist/examples/execution-router-demo.js && node dist/examples/capability-registry-demo.js
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:core && npm run build:portable && npm run build:assurance && npm run build:audit && npm run build:replay && npm run build:plugins && npm run build:isolation && npm run build:enterprise && npm run build:events && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:capabilities && npm run build:router && npm run build:compat-package
scripts.api:update: npm run build && node tools/api-snapshots.mjs update
scripts.semantics:update: npm run build:core && node tools/semantics-freeze.mjs update
